statement: The table shows the probability that a city soccer team scores each number of goals in a game. $$\begin{array}{c|c} \text{Goals} & \text{Probability} \\ \hline 0 & 0.20 \\ 1 & 0.35 \\ 2 & 0.30 \\ 3 & 0.15 \end{array}$$ What is the expected number of goals the team scores in a game?

choices.misconception: I averaged the four probabilities, but they always add to 1, so that average is 0.25 for any table and says nothing about goals.
I chose the most likely number of goals, 1, but the expected value weighs every outcome by its probability.
I averaged 0, 1, 2 and 3 as if they were equally likely, ignoring the probabilities.

hints: Expected value is a weighted average of the outcomes.
Multiply each number of goals by its probability, then add the products.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
